title: Enterprise risk review
description: Risk ownership and response decisions linked to strategy and operational plans.

rules.instruction: Describe each material risk as an event with a consequence for a named objective. Record the owner, current controls and proposed response.
rules.verification: Ask the owner to show the evidence for the current risk assessment and explain who can approve the response or accept the residual risk.

rules.instruction: Define which changes in exposure require a decision, who receives the escalation and when open actions are reviewed.
rules.verification: Run a tabletop walkthrough of one trigger and verify that the decision owner, evidence and response are available.
